big_case.notes: Changing the McDonnell Douglas framework at summary judgment could affect employment litigation nationwide. This petition arose from an unpublished, fact-intensive individual termination dispute and ended in a denial creating no new rule.

leakage.notes: The harness records forward mode on October 29, before the November 16 resolution, with all 20 calls captured. The broad McDonnell Douglas search could surface this petition and other pending petitions, as disclosed, but shows no target disposition. Other reads concern the provisioned August record, statpack, and Hittle. Later pre-resolution material is legitimate forward information.
